head: 0f82de7e8fab7e444d5eb4ae1d678a3851e2f5d0
method: Static npm physical-path resolution, Yarn v1 selector resolution and semver checks; dependency, optional, dev and peer edges retained. No install/resolver/build/runtime trials.
caveats: Yarn v1 does not encode peer edges; inferred peer ownership uses the npm graph and manifests.
32 Yarn selectors for optional/platform dependencies are absent; no alerted package is absent.
Candidate versions clear snapshot ranges only and must be re-audited at implementation time.
RANGE_COMPATIBLE is an incoming-range check, not an exploitability or runtime-compatibility result.
